# FranchiseKI — Franchise Brand & Territory Catalog

> A research catalog of 4,131 franchise brands built from each brand's own Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD). For each brand: franchise fee (Item 5), royalty (Item 6), total investment range (Item 7), the Item 12 territory rule in the FDD's own words, and Item 20 outlet counts by state. Territory availability is exclusion-based: the catalog states what the FDD's rule says and where existing units are; it never claims a specific area is available — only the franchisor can confirm that.

## Key pages
- Home / full catalog: /
- All brands A-Z: /brands/
- Territory guide (Item 12 rules + exclusion method): /territories/
- Compare brands side by side (fee, investment, royalty, Item 12 rule, availability): /compare/
- PerfectFit Quiz: /quiz/ — answer a few quick questions (liquid capital, net worth, maximum investment, target state, ownership style, categories, risk comfort, timeline) and every brand is scored client-side over /match-index.json across six weighted dimensions (Capital 25, Ownership 20, Risk 15, Industry 15, Location 15, Timeline 10). A dimension that cannot be scored from a brand's FDD disclosures is excluded from its denominator and labeled; brands scored on fewer than 3 dimensions carry no Fit Score.
- Consultants: /consultants/ — how the vetted consultant network works (vetted, not random; free to buyers because consultants are paid by franchisors; on the buyer's side of the table) and how to reach the FranchiseKI team.
- Brand pages carry a due diligence dossier where gate-passed FDD (fields100) data exists: Item 20 unit history, closures/transfers over the last 3 years, Item 3 litigation, Item 4 bankruptcy disclosure, Item 19 financial performance representations, ownership and training/support facts, company facts, and a questions-to-ask list generated only from fields the FDD does not disclose.
- Franchise Cost Index: /franchise-cost-index/ — FDD Item 7 total-investment benchmarks across 3,120 brands (census 2026-10-27): median cost by category, entry-cost distribution, and worked examples, with category pages for Food & Beverage (/franchise-cost-index/food-beverage/), Health & Fitness (/franchise-cost-index/health-fitness/), Business Services (/franchise-cost-index/business-services/) and Home Services (/franchise-cost-index/home-services/), a full methodology page (/franchise-cost-index/methodology/), and the per-brand dataset as CSV (/franchise-cost-index/dataset.csv).
- Best Franchises to Buy in 2027: /best-franchises-to-buy-2027/ — a criteria-based guide (Item 7 total investment, Item 19 basis, owner role, Item 20 system health) with six named entries and FDD-sourced figures; Franchise KI's franchisor referral-fee compensation is disclosed in the piece.
- Best AI Employee Platforms 2027: /best-ai-employee-platforms-2027/ — an alphabetical, unranked comparison of AI employee and AI workforce tools for franchises against six stated criteria; published by Advaita AI, which is one of the products covered and is disclosed as the publisher in the piece.
- How Much Does It Cost to Buy a Franchise: /how-much-does-it-cost-to-buy-a-franchise/ — the Item 7 explainer: why the franchise fee is not the cost, what Item 7 includes, recurring Item 6 fees, liquid capital, and how to verify any quoted figure in the FDD, with Salad House and Indy Clover as worked examples.
- Full-text search: /search/
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Data notes
- 2,080 brands carry a verified Item 12 territory classification (exclusive / protected / non-exclusive / none) with the FDD citation.
- 400 brands carry Item 20 state-by-state outlet data (graded PASS set).
- Figures are as disclosed in each brand's FDD at extraction time; verify current terms with the franchisor.
